title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 part 2 — Ambire and Enkrypt launch history
notes: Candidate IDs are provisional. Both launch records use first-party dated launch/introducing material; canonical launch fields must only be changed during fresh-main promotion if the existing product record and validator policy support the same precision.

events.title: Ambire Extension launched publicly
events.description: Ambire announced the official public launch of its browser extension after nearly a year of private testing, removing the invite-code requirement and making the extension generally available.

events.title: Enkrypt browser extension introduced
events.description: MyEtherWallet introduced Enkrypt as its multichain browser-extension wallet and directed users to download the released extension, with support for EVM and Polkadot ecosystem networks at release.

evidence.title: The Ambire Extension Launches Officially
evidence.notes: First-party Ambire launch article dated 2025-05-08; explicitly states the extension is out of private beta and available to all.

evidence.title: Introducing Enkrypt, the Browser Extension Wallet by MEW
evidence.notes: First-party MyEtherWallet publication introducing Enkrypt and directing users to download it on 2022-08-03.
